AgentReply.description: The final message of a turn.

message_class.description: Set when the reply is a catalog message (refusal or error).

trace_id.description: Also the reference ID shown with errors.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

AgentReply.title: AgentReply

ApiError.description:
The body of every refused request. A refused view carries its catalog message, as the
CLI prints it; a request with no identity, a missing turn or a bad window has none.
ApiError.title: ApiError

BrandScope.description:
The Brands a query or a Trio may touch.

``all_brands=True`` is an Executive's scope; otherwise ``brands`` is the exact set.
An empty Manager scope is legal and means "no data" (default deny).
BrandScope.title: BrandScope

ConfirmationRequest.description: The graph is paused at ``interrupt()``. Today only the Deletion Plan uses it.

require_count.description: Large plan: confirming all needs the count ("yes, delete all 37").
require_count.title: Require Count

trace_id.description: Also the reference ID shown with errors.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

ConfirmationRequest.title: ConfirmationRequest

DevUser.description: One seeded User for the prototype's identity picker. Never served in production.

brands.description: Brand Assignments; empty for an Executive (all).
brands.title: Brands

DevUser.title: DevUser

GateCheck.description: The five checks, in the order they run. Cheap code checks first.
GateCheck.title: GateCheck

reason.description: Plain words, with a hint, on failure.
reason.title: Reason

MessageClass.description: Keys of the message catalog. Each maps to one plain-language message with a next step.
MessageClass.title: MessageClass

Persona.description:
The editable layer of the prompt. Locked layers (safety rules, tool and output contracts)
live in code and cannot be overridden by anything here.

messages.description: Catalog wording overrides. Missing classes use the bundled wording.
messages.title: Messages

Persona.title: Persona

PersonaGateResult.description:
Pass or fail, and the result and reason of each check that ran.

Checks stop at the first failure, so a failed result may list fewer than five checks.

could_not_run.description: The gate could not run (e.g. model down): fail closed.
could_not_run.title: Could Not Run

PersonaGateResult.title: PersonaGateResult

message_class.description: PERSONA_GATE_FAILED, or MODEL_BUSY when the gate could not run.

ProfileNote.description: A short free-text preference. Passes the input guard; injected as data.
ProfileNote.title: ProfileNote

ProgressEvent.description:
A templated phrase plus tool and table names, never free model text.

Passes the regex detectors only, so it adds no Sensitive Data Protection call (HLD 03).

trace_id.description: Also the reference ID shown with errors.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

ProgressEvent.title: ProgressEvent

ReportListItem.description: One row of ``list_my_reports``. Content is withheld when the scope check fails.

accessible.description: False when the report covers a Brand the User no longer has (HLD 04).
accessible.title: Accessible

ReportListItem.title: ReportListItem

ReportStructured.description: The structured part of a Saved Report (``saved_reports.structured``).

summary.description: Short summary, written by the analysis model at save time (ADR 0009).
summary.title: Summary

ReportStructured.title: ReportStructured

SavedReport.description:
A question, the SQL that answered it and the answer, saved on the User's explicit request.

Private to its Author. Every field has already passed the output PII filter (ADR 0003).

data_as_of.description: Shown as "data as of <date>" when the report is opened.
data_as_of.title: Data As Of

markdown.description: The exact text the User saw.
markdown.title: Markdown

scope.description: Brands the data covers, from the query guard.

sql.description: The SQL the model wrote, before the guard's scope rewrite.
sql.title: Sql

turn_id.description: With conversation_id, the idempotency key of save_report.
turn_id.title: Turn Id

SavedReport.title: SavedReport

SpanNode.description: One line of the ``/trace`` step tree.
SpanNode.title: SpanNode

StatsView.description: The metric families of HLD 08, computed from trace attributes only.
StatsView.title: StatsView

WebConfirmation.description: The Deletion Plan's checkboxes and buttons.
WebConfirmation.title: WebConfirmation

One turn: ``event:`` is the message's ``kind``, ``data:`` its JSON. The stream
closes after a ``reply`` or a ``confirmation``.

put.description:
``changes`` maps a field (``emphasis``, ``tone.preset``, ``messages.model_busy``,
``report_sections``) to its new value; the Quality Gate judges it.
